answer: Standing lapses unless 4 peers re-attest it every 20 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in kernel and mesa lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those since the attesters must be independent on the vault graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1252 impostors cost 1551 times the honest price and take 25 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
